tasks.short: Advise on energy systems and sustainable design.

steps.what: Retrieve actual system information, energy evidence and the client's question
Determine appropriate technical advice and qualify energy-performance claims
Discuss actual systems, options and limitations with the client or colleague
Write and check final technical advice and source links for the actual recipient
outputs: checked final energy advice and recipient

steps.what: Send the checked final technical advice to the external client
inputs: checked final energy advice and recipient

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS}/{OTHER} system-source links and advice fields. Engineer retains technical conclusions and actual discussion; repeated source retrieval and written-layout work reduce before an exact final-advice send gate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated evidence navigation and advice layout.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source views and reusable fields.
tasks.still_hard: Matching options to real systems and credible energy claims.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the recipient's constraints and explain technical trade-offs.
tasks.altitude: Less preparation repetition; technical advice authority unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native source links and advice fields reduce repeated preparation without selecting energy-system advice.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual advice discussion and an actual written follow-up, not an invented report for every conversation. Client supplies actual question; system owner supplies specification, operating conditions and source revision; measurement owner actual values and units. Engineer resolves gaps in s1, selects advice in s2 and writes actual discussion outcome in s4. Oral-only cases require actual reweighting.

outputs: actual energy measurements and commissioning observations

steps.what: Reconcile actual meter and logger exports with building operating conditions
inputs: actual energy measurements and commissioning observations

inputs: draft energy model and verification results

tasks.still_hard: Measurement adequacy, weather and occupancy effects and model validity.
tasks.human_edge: Determine whether actual evidence demonstrates the claimed performance.

tasks.short: Verify energy bills and meter readings.

steps.what: Capture actual bill line items and reconcile meter identifiers, periods and units
Recalculate tariff amounts and flag specified bill-to-meter discrepancies
inputs: engineer checked tariff and discrepancy rules

steps.what: Investigate actual discrepancies and determine whether bills and readings are valid
Write and check actual verification findings and unresolved billing questions
Save the final bill verification record

tasks.design: Configure native {ERP}/{OTHER} bill and meter exports with checked {SPREADSHEET} tariff calculations and exception rules. Engineer resolves real discrepancies and signs the final findings through ordinary record checking; no automatic payment approval or supplier dispute send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated bill/meter retyping and tariff arithmetic.
tasks.enabler_now: Native exports and deterministic reconciliation rules.
tasks.still_hard: Estimated readings, meter changes, tariff scope and unexplained usage.
tasks.human_edge: Explain actual exceptions and distinguish invalid charges from valid changes.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated verification arithmetic; billing judgement unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native bill/meter exports and deterministic tariff calculations can flag discrepancies without determining every bill's validity or approving payment.

assumptions: Boundary is energy engineer verification through findings record, not accounts-payable approval. Supplier produces actual line items, period, tariff and amount; meter owner actual ID, readings, timestamps, units and estimate flags; contract owner tariff terms. Engineer reconciles and manually enters missing fields and checks tariff/rule mapping in s1 before s2. Unsupported scanned bills remain manual, no free extraction.

Native first; existing automated calculations and runtime earn zero saving. Provisional arithmetic25 represents human repeated checks, not software execution. Investigation40, writing9 and save1 unchanged; shares unmeasured. No monetary or performance baseline invented.

research_questions: Can fixed rules identify mismatched periods and units without guessing missing readings?

tasks.short: Review building plans for energy efficiency.

steps.what: Locate current architectural, mechanical and electrical plans and actual efficiency criteria
Extract actual building areas, envelope properties and system specifications for energy comparisons
Evaluate actual plan choices, system interactions and energy-efficiency implications
Write and check actual plan-review comments and qualifications
Save the final energy plan-review comments

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} revision views and {OTHER} building-model attribute schedules. Engineer still reads plans, resolves unsupported attributes and evaluates efficiency; mapped quantities do not establish a compliant or efficient design.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated revision lookup and plan-attribute transcription.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document relationships and building-model schedules.
tasks.still_hard: System interactions, operating assumptions and missing design detail.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise inefficient choices and explain justified alternatives.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated plan preparation; energy review authority unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native building-model schedules can expose supplied areas and system attributes while expert review determines energy implications.

assumptions: Boundary is plan review through actual comments save. Architect and services designers produce actual revision, object IDs, areas, envelope and equipment attributes with units. Engineer retrieves sources in s1 and manually measures or resolves missing attributes in s2; no free digitisation of drawings. Fixed schedules only for actual structured model attributes, unsupported plans remain manual.
